names.ja: ドラセナ・ゴッドセフィアナ
aliases: ドラセナ・スルクロサ

light.best.quote: This easy-to-grow houseplant requires bright but not direct light.

light.min.quote: Deep shade (Less than 2 hours to no direct sunlight)

light.directSun.quote: requires bright but not direct light

temperature.minC.quote: bring it inside when the temperature goes below 50 degrees Fahrenheit at night

temperature.idealC.quote: Dracaenas are best grown in normal house temperatures of 60 to 70 °F during the day.

humidity.quote: keep the humidity high by sitting the pot on a pebble tray with water

watering.growing.quote: Keep the soil moist during the regular growing season, but overwatering and standing water will cause root rot.

watering.winter.reason: 出典に冬の記載がないため、室温が下がると水を吸う量が減ることから一段乾かし気味とした

tips.ja: 光が強すぎると葉が茶色くなったり落ちたりし、弱すぎると斑の色があせる。
tips.quote: The leaves will brown or drop if the light is too high, and they can lose their intense coloring if the light is too low.

note: 以前の学名は Dracaena godseffiana。
